meta.title: Agent cursors on the canvas
meta.summary: Each agent working on a comment shows up on the canvas as a multiplayer-style cursor with a name tag and its own color. It stays near the comment and follows pan and zoom. When the screen changes, it glides to the changed element, outlines it and clicks. Waiting agents show a question mark; finished ones show a check and fade out.
meta.simulatedData: Four comment tasks with no chat and no thread (one waiting for an answer, two working, one failed) written to the mod's local store; status changes come from a simulation layer over its API. The agent's edit was a CSS class change in DogHomeScreen.tsx inside the project clone, undone at the end.

meta.title: Automatic canvas setup
meta.summary: When the Design home shows the "Set up canvases" empty state, the mod presses the setup button by itself after about a second, once per workspace, and shows a toast that explains why a chat opened. By default it also presses Send in that new chat, which starts an agent run. On the "This branch needs canvas setup" variant it does nothing.
meta.simulatedData: This account has no project without canvases, so the "Set up canvases" variant (the only one where the mod acts) never shows. On a workspace without canvas setup, the variant was forced in the renderer (hasProjectCanvases=false in the props the mod reads), auto-send stayed off and the click on the app's button was intercepted: no chat opened and nothing was sent. The auto-send step was not captured, since it would start a real agent run.

meta.title: Canvas comment becomes a Claude task
meta.summary: A comment you post on a canvas becomes a task for a Claude chat that runs in the background while you stay on the canvas. The mod tracks its status and captures the commented area before and after. When the run ends, it replies in the comment thread with a short summary and the images. Without the bubbles mod, tasks appear in a compact list over the sidebar.
meta.simulatedData: Four comment tasks with no chat and no thread (one waiting for an answer, two working, one failed) written to the mod's local store; status changes come from a simulation layer over its API. The typed comment was cancelled, never sent, so no chat or thread reply was created.

meta.title: Paste images at the pointer
meta.summary: Pasting an image on the canvas (⌘V) now puts its top-left corner exactly at the mouse pointer. In the original Tempo the image lands far away, to the right of every storyboard.
